description: Robinhood Chain tokens that several distinct wallets each bought within the last hour (a buy of at least 0.05 WETH by default), from the RobinX wallet tape (the sender of every swap the index folds): wallets, buys, WETH, first and last buy, and template_launch for launch-template farms whose launches fund their own buyers. Counts only, wallets never identified. Defaults: 60 minutes, 3+ wallets, 0.05+ WETH per buy. An observation about buying, not a signal to trade. Included on Alpha and Omega keys; otherwise $0.02 USDC on Base. (paid $0.02, or included in a RobinX plan key — see instructions)

min_weth.description: WETH a buy must reach to count, default 0.05, floor 0.01
